name: Personality Test
description: Front-end DISC-style personality quiz whose results are POSTed to a route and saved as a node.
project_description:
Introducing the Personality Test Drupal Module - This module is designed to help users gain insight into their personality traits. Through a series of questions, users can complete a test that assesses their Dominance (D), Influence (I), Steadiness (S), and Conscientiousness (C) traits. Once the test is completed, users receive a detailed report indicating the percentage of each trait they possess. This information is then saved in their

node with the content type "personality assessment test," allowing them to reference and track their results over time.

 

 

 What It Does: 
 

 

 
 
 Understand Yourself: 
 Our personality test module helps you understand yourself better by asking simple questions about your preferences and behaviors.

 
 
 Discover Your Traits: 
 Through our module, you'll uncover insights about your personality traits, like whether you're outgoing, analytical, or empathetic.

 
 
 User-Friendly Interface: 
 Our module features a user-friendly interface, making it easy for anyone to navigate and complete the assessment.
